title: Introducing the Agents API
summary: Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use.
body: Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了全新的Agents API，作为一项托管服务，它由Codex底层驱动，专注于为开发者提供工作流编排、长生命周期会话管理以及工具调用能力，从而简化云端智能体的构建与发布流程。原始信息显示：Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing the Agents API”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了基于Codex驱动的Agents API，为构建托管云智能体提供编排支持。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
